fml.menu.mods.info.description.cartofold: One map engine for the minimap, the world map, the paper maps and the maps of the other mods.
key.cartofold.open_map: Open the map of the world
cartofold.worldmap.title: Map of the world
cartofold.worldmap.hint: Drag: move · Wheel: zoom · Right click: waypoint · Space: center · Page Up/Down: caves
cartofold.waypoint.name: Name
cartofold.configuration.title: Cartofold settings
cartofold.configuration.minimap.tooltip: The minimap on the screen of the game.
Show the minimap. The key Y also shows and hides it.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.corner.t: The corner of the screen of the minimap.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.size.too: The size of the minimap, in units of the screen.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.zoom.too: The zoom level of the minimap, from 0 (far) to 4 (near). The keys [ and ] also change it.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.rotate.t: Turn the minimap with the player. If off, the north is at the top.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.coordina: Show the coordinates of the player under the minimap.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.waypoint: Show the waypoints on the minimap.
cartofold.configuration.worldmap.tooltip: The map of the world (key M).
cartofold.configuration.worldmap.waypoin: Show the waypoints on the map of the world.
Show the names of the waypoints
Show the names of the waypoints on the map of the world.
cartofold.layers.title: Layers of the maps
cartofold.configuration.layers.tooltip: The layers of the other mods. The "Layers" button of the map of the world also shows and hides them.
cartofold.configuration.layers.hidden.to: The identifiers of the layers that the views do not show.
cartofold.cartography.tooltip.north: Move the map by half of its side to the north. Needs a paper.
cartofold.cartography.tooltip.south: Move the map by half of its side to the south. Needs a paper.
cartofold.cartography.tooltip.west: Move the map by half of its side to the west. Needs a paper.
cartofold.cartography.tooltip.east: Move the map by half of its side to the east. Needs a paper.
cartofold.cartography.tooltip.zoom: Make a new map with the next scale. Needs a paper.
cartofold.cartography.tooltip.update: Paint the map from the generated land, 1024 chunks at most. Needs a paper.
cartofold.cartography.detail.no_input: Put an item under the map
cartofold.cartography.detail.max_scale: Select a move or the update
cartofold.configuration.minimap.caves.to: In a cave, the minimap shows the caves at the height of the player. The map of the world opens on the caves too.
cartofold.configuration.layers.banner_vi: The views that show the banners that the player marked on a map.
Minimap and map of the world
cartofold.configuration.markers.tooltip: The markers on the minimap, on the map of the world and in the map frames.
cartofold.configuration.markers.scale.to: The scale of the markers, of their names and of the arrow of the player. 1 is the default size.
key.cartofold.toggle_hud: Show or hide the markers in the world
cartofold.layers.hud.tooltip: Show the markers of the layer in the world. Some layers do not show in the world.
cartofold.configuration.hud.tooltip: The waypoints and the markers of the layers in the world, with their icon, their name and their distance. The key U also shows and hides them.
cartofold.configuration.hud.enabled: Show the markers in the world
cartofold.configuration.hud.enabled.tool: Show the waypoints and the markers in the world. The key U also shows and hides them.
cartofold.configuration.hud.waypoints.to: Show the waypoints in the world.
cartofold.configuration.hud.min_distance: Hide the markers nearer than this distance, in blocks.
cartofold.configuration.hud.max_distance: Hide the markers farther than this distance, in blocks. 0 shows all the far markers.
cartofold.configuration.hud.opacity.tool: The opacity of the markers, in percent.
cartofold.configuration.hud.height.toolt: The height of a marker above its position, in blocks.
cartofold.configuration.hud.scale.toolti: The size of the markers: 1 is the normal size.
cartofold.configuration.hud.names.toolti: Show the names of the markers.
cartofold.configuration.hud.distances.to: Show the distances of the markers.
cartofold.configuration.hud.hidden_layer: The identifiers of the layers that do not show in the world. The "HUD" buttons of the "Layers" screen also show and hide them.
